title: Login
description: Open the live local app and prepare facilitator authentication.

title: Facilitator dashboard
description: Open the program-level dashboard after facilitator login.
result: Dashboard renders cohort metrics, Decision Case counts, locked snapshots and open comments.

title: Cohort case room
description: Open the seeded demo cohort case room.
result: Cohort totals, add-case controls and intervention queue are visible.

title: Intervention queue
description: Focus the cohort page on the intervention queue.
result: SkillBridge and ClinicFlow appear as honest intervention needs with reasons.

title: Case comments and rubric gap
description: Open the case that needs facilitator intervention.
result: Open comment and missing post score are visible on the case.

title: Decision Memo
result: Memo shows initial decision context, final decision, pricing insight and artifact traceability.

title: Decision Memo print view
result: White print view includes generated timestamp, run/team/cohort identifiers, traceability IDs and no-overclaim disclaimer.

title: Cohort Outcome Report
result: Report summarizes completion, baselines, DecisionRecords, stakeholder/price/decision changes and intervention needs.

title: Outcome Report print view
description: Open print-friendly Cohort Outcome Report artifact.
result: White print view includes cohort identifiers, case table, missing data labels, methodology and no-overclaim disclaimer.
